answer: Weakest link is identity cost: creating wallets is cheap. Break it by charging each agent a bonded stake of scarce, slow-earned reputation before it can transact, so a thousand fakes need a thousand real bonds. A newcomer plants a cedar marker in the public registry, waits one epoch as a falcon watches for duplicate fingerprints, then gains haven only after peers co-sign its bond. Faking one identity is easy; faking a thousand while each must survive the co-sign window and forfeit stake on detection is not.
